title: 6 SIGNS YOU’RE ABOUT TO MAKE A BAD DECISION
paragraphs: 6 SIGNS YOU’RE ABOUT TO MAKE A BAD DECISION
You don’t feel it at first.
It doesn’t announce itself as destruction.
It feels… justified. Logical. Even necessary.

But here’s what most people don’t realize…
Bad decisions rarely look evil in the beginning—they feel right in the moment.
And that’s the trap.
If this found you, it’s not by accident.
Before you take your next step, read this slowly. Then read it again.
And if something in you starts to tighten… pay attention.
1. You’re Rushing What Should Be Weighed
God is not anxious.
But you are.
You feel pressure to decide now. No pause. No prayer. No counsel.
That urgency? It’s often not wisdom—it’s fear dressed as momentum.
Read that again.
When decisions outrun discernment, consequences catch up later.
2. You’re Avoiding the Truth You Already Know
You’ve already felt the warning.
That quiet conviction.
But you’re negotiating with it.
Reframing it. Dismissing it. Delaying it.
Why?
Because obedience costs something your flesh doesn’t want to lose.
But here’s the danger—every time you silence conviction, your heart gets quieter toward God.
Originally written by Gospel Warrior.
3. You’re Seeking Confirmation, Not Correction
You’re not asking, “Is this right?”
You’re asking, “Who will agree with me?”
So you filter voices. You ignore accountability. You highlight opinions that support your desire.
That’s not wisdom.
That’s self-deception with witnesses.
4. You’re Driven by Emotion, Not Truth
Anger. Loneliness. Attraction. Pride.
Emotions are real—but they are terrible leaders.
When emotion takes the wheel, truth gets pushed into the backseat.
And decisions made in emotional storms often become lifelong regrets.
5. You’re Compromising “Just This Once”
It’s small.
It’s subtle.
It’s “not that serious.”
But sin never stays small.
What you call a moment… Scripture calls a doorway.
And once you step through it, it rarely leads where you expected.
6. You’re Leaving God Out of the Equation
No prayer.
No Scripture.
No surrender.
Just you… deciding your own path.
That’s the most dangerous place to be.
Because the core issue isn’t just a bad decision—
It’s separation from the One who gives life.
THE BREAKING POINT
Here’s the truth most people don’t want to hear:
Bad decisions aren’t just mistakes.
They reveal something deeper—
A heart choosing self over God.
That’s sin.
And sin always leads somewhere…
Brokenness. Distance. Death of purpose.
But it doesn’t have to end there.
THE GOSPEL SHIFT
Jesus didn’t come for people who always choose right.
He came for people who keep choosing wrong.
He saw the pattern.
He saw the cycle.
And He stepped in.
Through His death and resurrection, He made a way:

From confusion → clarity
From sin → forgiveness
From destruction → redemption
Not by your effort.
Not by fixing yourself.
But by grace… through faith in Him alone.
THE INVITATION
So here’s the real question:

Will you keep trusting your instincts…
Or finally surrender your decisions to Christ?
Because one leads to regret.
The other leads to life.

That’s not coincidence.
That’s conviction.
